MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In MANDARIN CHINESE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening ● Verbal and non-verbal cues ● Summarisin g ● Paraphrasin g ● C.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening ● Verbal and non-verbal cues ● Summarisin g ● Paraphrasin g ● C.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening ● Verbal and non-verbal cues ● Summarisin g ● Paraphrasin g ● C.

1. B — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

2. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening ● Verbal and non-verbal cues ● Summarisin g ● Paraphrasin g ● C.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information ● Reading strategies ● Vocabulary development ● Text str.

10. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening Comprehension ● Active listening ● Summarising.

11. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency ● Reading with expression ● Accuracy of articulation ● Pronuncia.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Writing Mechanics ● Punctuation ● Punctuation marks ● Spelling ● Word order; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Descriptive Writing ● Clarity ● Coherence ● Logic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Creative Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Verbs ● The verbs 喜 欢 and 不喜 欢 ● The modal verb 会 ● The Verb 过 ● Sentence struct; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
